product.description:
Family Kayak Adventure in Collie

Kayaking on the Collie River at Minningup Pool

Adults: $79 | Kids (9–14 yrs): $59

Make the most of the school holidays with a fun, active and refreshing outdoor experience the whole family will love. Family Paddle & Play – School Holiday Adventure is designed for families wanting to get moving, reconnect with nature and enjoy quality time together away from screens, stress and busy routines.

Set on the beautiful Collie River at Minningup Pool, this 2-hour guided kayaking session takes place on calm, sheltered waters—perfect for first-time paddlers, confident kids and families looking for a safe, enjoyable and meaningful outdoor activity in Collie.

What to Expect

Fun, Safe and Easy Kayaking

Your session begins with a friendly safety briefing and simple paddling instruction to help everyone feel confident on the water. The group stays together and moves at a relaxed family pace while exploring the natural surroundings of Minningup Pool.

Family-Friendly Paddling

This experience is designed specifically for families. There’s no pressure and no rushing—just gentle paddling, floating, exploring and sharing moments together.

Swim, Splash and Play

Depending on conditions, children and adults can enjoy supervised opportunities for a dip, splash or cool-off during the session.

Nature Discovery

Learn about local wildlife, listen to the sounds of the river and help kids build a deeper appreciation for nature, mindful moments and adventure.

Choose Your Session

Morning: Fresh air and gentle sunshine—an energising start to the day.
Afternoon: Warm weather and golden afternoon light—perfect for relaxed paddling.

Health & Wellbeing Benefits
  • Builds confidence and resilience in kids
  • Encourages movement, balance and coordination
  • Reduces stress and improves mood
  • Promotes screen-free time outdoors
  • Strengthens family connection through shared experiences
  • Supports healthy, active holiday time
What’s Included
  • Guided family-friendly kayaking experience
  • High-quality kayaks, paddles and safety equipment
  • Introduction to paddling techniques
  • Nature interpretation and simple water-based activities
  • Photos of your adventure taken for you
Who Is This Tour Perfect For?

This experience is ideal for families with children aged 9–14 years who enjoy:

  • Outdoor adventure
  • Nature and fresh air
  • Fun, safe activities
  • Movement and exploration
  • Quality family time
Book Your School Holiday Adventure

Give your family the gift of movement, nature and connection these school holidays. Limited spaces are available for each session.

FAQ’s

Is this activity suitable for beginners?
Yes. The Collie River at Minningup Pool has calm water, making it ideal for first-time paddlers and families.

What age is this tour suitable for?
This tour is perfect for children aged 9–14 years and their accompanying adults.

Do we need to be able to swim?
Basic water confidence is recommended. All participants wear provided PFDs for safety.

Where does the tour take place?
The session is held on the Collie River at Minningup Pool, just a short drive from Collie, Western Australia.

Are parents required to join their children on the water?
Yes, all children must be accompanied by a participating adult.

Can we bring our own kayaks?
For safety and consistency, all participants use the equipment provided.

What should we bring?
Comfortable outdoor clothing, a hat, water, sunscreen, and a towel if you plan to swim.

Will the session run in all weather?
The tour runs in most conditions, but may be rescheduled in the event of unsafe weather.
